notes.title: Patch 1.5.3
notes.content: This came a few minutes after the previous patch, a change I made in that one prevented the game from launching at all. Its fixed now.

notes.title: Another tiny patch 1.5.3
notes.content: 1. Invert Mouse can now be toggled on or off from the pause menu.

notes.title: Tiny patch 1.5.2
notes.content: 1. Further fixed an issue that was preventing Sprint / Crouch to be bound.

notes.title: Patch 1.5.1
notes.content: 1. Fixed issue with key bindings not applying properly.

notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.content:
Patch 1.5

By very popular request

In the Pause Menu, added a button to toggle camera motion OFF/ON. By default it is on, so now you can easily toggle it off.

Sorry to everyone that I made dizzy with it.

notes.title: Small patch 1.4.3
notes.content: Num lock or F12 (either one) toggles the post process camera movement off or on. By default it is on.

notes.title: Emergency patch 1.4.2
notes.content:
Emergency patch

During the previous patch I broke something that prevented the player from leaving the boat in stage #2 (the glowing-green-pillar-stage). It's been fixed. Also the boat in Stage #2 cant be skipped, that is intended, since you shouldnt die in stage #2.

notes.title: Patch 1.4.1
notes.content:
Tiny update, it's more of an update in progress.

Someone asked me on the forum to have a way to disable the camera shake and tilt.

Pressing NUM LOCK will disable it.
It's a very rudimentary system and you will have to press it every time a new map starts, I will have a more permanent UI solution in the following days.

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
Hey all I added another patch.

Changelog:

1. [b]After dying once (it does not matter how), you can now skip the intro sequence.[/b]

2. [b]The sacrifice room has been much improved; hopefully it is clearer now what the player is supposed to do if he decides to leave the suicide platform.[/b]

3. [b]The dark entity moves much faster, do not linger in that room after you leave the platform, leg it to the boat![/b]

4. In anticipation for the second chapter, the "Chamber Beneath" started getting redesigned. 

5. [b]Performance has been much improved while retaining all the graphical fidelity. Everyone should see at least a 30% increase in FPS.[/b]

6. Fix an achievement sometimes triggering when it should not.

7. Fixed some sound issues.


Thanks for your patience !

notes.title: Patch 3
notes.content:
Added achivements ! 
Fixed various bugs.
Improved different aspects of the game.
The shadow now moves much faster. 

Improved the final packaging size of the game, it should be 7.8 instead of 8.3GB now

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content:
Emergency patch #2

Fixed the player not being able to move on the second stage (the "error stage")

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
Added some quick changes:

1. Player can now sprint
2. Ghost will move much faster. Dont linger.
3. Minor graphical fixes, unrelated to gameplay.
